name: Anthion’s parting words

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: With the top piece returned, Anthion explains the danger that he could not see before. The Veiled Blade split Valthalak’s amulet into three parts out of greed, not knowing that it held much of the warlock’s soul. The curse followed. Anthion asks the seeker to find Bodley, who can guide the search for the other pieces. At last, Anthion believes he may rest; his part in the company’s wrong has become a plea to set it right.
